about.title: 关于我
paragraphs: 我是一名对 Web 与移动端开发充满热情的学生，具备运用现代技术构建高质量全栈应用的丰富经验。
我热衷于解决复杂问题、学习前沿技术并探索创新解决方案。在学术与个人项目中，我不断夯实自身的技术能力、分析思维与跨文化团队协作素养。
在编程之外，我也积极从事数字内容创作：视频剪辑、视觉设计与音乐制作。我始终保持对技术的好奇心，期待在国际化视野中参与富有影响力的项目，成长为优秀的软件工程师。

items.title: FREPPING
items.tagline: AI-Powered 3D Clothing Customization and Virtual Fashion Experience.
items.description: A virtual clothing customization platform that allows users to explore garments, personalize designs, and preview their creations in an interactive 3D environment.
items.overview: FREPPING is an interactive fashion technology platform designed to transform the way users explore, customize, and visualize clothing. The platform combines 3D modeling, artificial intelligence, and interactive garment customization to provide users with a more personalized fashion experience.
items.problem: 3D clothing customization is typically reserved for professional designers with specialized software. Casual users cannot easily visualize or personalize garments before purchase, leading to returns and dissatisfaction.
items.solution: FREPPING brings an accessible 3D customization environment directly to the browser. Users can explore garments, modify colors, textures, logos, and structural elements in real time — no professional 3D experience required.

features.title: Interactive 3D Garment Viewer
features.description: Explore clothing in full 3D with rotation, zoom, and inspection.

features.title: AI-Assisted Model Generation
features.description: Generate and modify 3D clothing models using artificial intelligence.

features.title: Custom Texture & Color Upload
features.description: Upload your own textures and apply colors to any garment element.

features.title: Logo & Sticker Placement
features.description: Position custom graphics interactively on the garment surface.

features.title: Real-Time Preview
features.description: See changes reflected immediately in the 3D environment.

features.title: UV Mapping & Material Control
features.description: Fine-grained control over garment materials and UV map regions.

challenges: Rendering performant 3D models in the browser while maintaining smooth interactivity.
Managing UV mapping and material zones for diverse garment geometries.
Integrating AI-assisted model generation into a responsive web interface.
Building scalable API infrastructure to support both real-time and batch operations.

items.title: FREPPING Backend
items.tagline: Scalable API Infrastructure for an AI-Powered 3D Fashion Platform.
items.description: A backend service designed to support the FREPPING platform, providing APIs and server-side functionality for its application features.
items.overview: The FREPPING Backend provides the APIs and application services required to support user accounts, product-related operations, and interactive customization workflows. It is designed to serve a modern web application that combines 3D content, AI-powered functionality, and personalized product discovery.
items.problem: A 3D fashion platform requires a reliable, scalable backend that can handle user sessions, product data, caching for real-time requests, and advanced search for personalization.
items.solution: A modular FastAPI backend with SQLAlchemy for ORM, Alembic for migrations, Redis for caching, and Elasticsearch for personalized product discovery — all wired together with JWT authentication.

features.title: RESTful API Architecture
features.description: Clean, versioned endpoints serving the FREPPING frontend.

features.title: JWT Authentication
features.description: Secure token-based user authentication and session management.

features.title: Redis Caching
features.description: Reduces repeated database queries for frequently accessed product data.

features.title: Elasticsearch Integration
features.description: Powers advanced product search and personalized discovery.

features.title: Alembic Migrations
features.description: Versioned schema changes for safe database evolution.

features.title: Modular Service Design
features.description: Separation of concerns across product, user, and AI service modules.

challenges: Designing a caching strategy that remains consistent during product updates.
Integrating Elasticsearch to support relevance-tuned search results.
Keeping API response times low during high-volume customization interactions.

items.title: Win Na9ra
items.tagline: A Student Guide to Discovering University Life in Tunisia.
items.description: A web-based project designed to provide users with an accessible online platform through a simple and responsive interface.
items.overview: Win Na9ra is a web application designed to help new students discover and understand university life in Tunisia. The platform centralizes useful information about universities, study locations, surrounding cities, and student services — making the transition into university smoother.
items.problem: New students arriving in a university city often struggle to find reliable, centralized information about housing, transportation, local costs, and student services.
items.solution: Win Na9ra aggregates all this information into an accessible web interface with an interactive map, navigation aids, and curated points of interest around Tunisian universities.

items.title: MarketFlow AI
items.tagline: An Intelligent Microservices Platform for Multichannel Digital Marketing.
items.description: A business management platform based on a microservices architecture, providing user management, workspaces, permissions, and workflow automation.
items.overview: MarketFlow AI is an intelligent digital marketing management platform developed as a final-year graduation project. It addresses the fragmentation of modern marketing operations by bringing social media, email campaigns, content generation, analytics, and customer engagement together in a centralized platform powered by AI and a modular microservices architecture.
items.problem: Businesses must manage social media, email campaigns, content generation, analytics, and customer engagement through multiple disconnected tools — creating operational silos, inconsistency, and wasted time.
items.solution: MarketFlow AI centralizes all these capabilities in one platform built on six independent microservices connected through a central API Gateway. AI assistance handles content generation, campaign automation, and performance analysis.

features.title: Authentication Service
features.description: JWT + OAuth, role-based access control, multi-tenant workspace management.

features.title: Email Hub Service
features.description: Campaign management, templates, contact segmentation, open/click tracking.

features.title: Social Media Service
features.description: Multi-platform publishing to Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, X, TikTok, YouTube.

features.title: AI Studio Service

features.title: Analytics Service
features.description: KPI dashboards, ROI calculation, performance monitoring, and alerts.

features.title: ARIA — Assistance Bot
features.description: Natural-language AI assistant that can trigger platform operations via WebSocket.

challenges: Coordinating six independent services through a centralized API Gateway without coupling.
Implementing real-time WebSocket communication for the ARIA assistant bot.
Designing a multi-tenant architecture with proper role-based access isolation.
Integrating multiple AI providers (Groq, Gemini) with consistent output formats.
Connecting to six social media OAuth flows with varied API rate limits.
achievements: Six fully implemented and independently deployable microservices
Centralized API Gateway with routing and authentication middleware
AI-powered content generation with Groq and Gemini integrations
Real-time conversational assistant (ARIA) with WebSocket support
Comprehensive analytics dashboard with ROI tracking

items.title: SignVi AI – FastAPI
items.tagline: Computer Vision and Deep Learning for Sign Language Recognition.
items.description: A backend-oriented repository associated with SignVi AI, an artificial intelligence project focused on sign-language-related technology.
items.overview: SignVi AI – FastAPI is the Python-based backend of the SignVi AI educational platform. It focuses on processing visual input, connecting trained deep-learning models to application APIs, and enabling gesture recognition for sign language learning.
items.problem: Sign language learning apps need a backend capable of processing real-time video input and running inference on deep learning models at acceptable latency.
items.solution: A FastAPI service wraps PyTorch and OpenCV-based gesture recognition pipelines, exposing clean REST endpoints for the Angular frontend to consume.

features.title: Model Training Infrastructure
features.description: Training scripts and evaluation pipelines for gesture classifiers.

challenges: Achieving low-latency inference suitable for real-time interactive use.
Handling diverse hand poses, lighting conditions, and camera quality.

items.title: SignVi AI
items.tagline: Learn Sign Language Through Artificial Intelligence.
items.description: An artificial intelligence project exploring technology for sign-language recognition and communication.
items.overview: SignVi AI is an interactive educational application designed to make sign-language learning more accessible through artificial intelligence. Users practice sign-language gestures through the camera and receive AI-assisted feedback on their performance.
items.problem: Learning sign language typically requires a human instructor. Most people cannot access in-person tuition, making the barrier to entry very high.
items.solution: Using MediaPipe for real-time hand tracking and an AI recognition backend, SignVi AI creates an interactive solo learning experience with immediate gesture feedback.

challenges: Achieving real-time gesture recognition at 30fps without GPU acceleration in the browser.
Designing a learning flow that adapts to different user skill levels.

items.title: Virtual Medical Coaching
